QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_41

question.text: Which of the following requires PRIOR approval from SEBI for a merchant banker?

answer.text: Change in control of the merchant banking entity
Change in the registered office address
Appointment of a new compliance officer

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM-Series-IX (p.83) requires prior SEBI approval where the merchant banker proposes a change in control. For changes in the information already submitted with the registration application, intimation to SEBI is required within seven working days. The Trap: "Intimation within seven working days" is not the same as prior approval — only change in control triggers the prior-approval requirement on p.83. Note: Specific examples (registered office, compliance officer, principal officer) fall under the seven-working-day intimation route per source unless separately documented; broader claims like an "indirect parent-company control trigger" should be sourced before being asserted.
